status: Frozen before clean-frame extraction and both independent geometry reviews
purpose: Blinded visible-instance geometry diagnostic on uniformly sampled exposed frames; no replacement truth, alternative pass score, retuning or new model inference
selection: Four uniformly spaced midpoints per exposed300-second panel; timestamp=start+37+75*k,k=0..3; independent of scores/predictions/publisher boxes
closed_seconds: 3000 and later; no extraction or review

geometry.coordinates: Native source xyxy pixel bounds, x2/y2 exclusive; tight around all visible pixels of ONE animal incl head/feet/tail, never infer hidden extent
geometry.include: Every visible animal including partial/occluded/edge fragments; local anonymous letters per frame, no fixed-count assumption; uncertain fragments retained and flagged
geometry.occlusion: Record occluded=true when another animal/fixture hides body; record uncertain=true for questionable presence or inseparable instance extent; explain in note

schema.review_kind: Independent AI-assisted visible geometry review; not external human annotation

objects.local_id: A,B,etc; no persistent or biological meaning
objects.note: clear reason for ambiguity or truncation

blinding.phase1: Both reviewers see only clean source centers and fixed +/-1sec context. No publisher/predicted boxes, masks, names, confidences or outcomes; no sharing labels until both full reviews frozen. Known prior general scene exposure disclosed.
blinding.phase2: Freeze both annotation files; compare disagreements explicitly, preserve originals; only then show original publisher geometry and all model outputs for these same20frames. No alternate precision/coverage/pass score.

prior_exposure: Both agents previously reviewed this public scene. Cattle reviewer reports none of these centers coincide with35 reserved-error frames; previous development scene exposure remains a limitation.
